title: JSON Mode Enforcer & Multi‑Model Schema Regression e2e
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create an automated end-to-end regression suite and enforcement gate that validates JSON Mode and constrained decoding across the model catalog, with special emphasis on streaming responses and tool/function-calling interaction patterns. Background: Recent regressions surfaced when streaming responses interleave partial tokens that then fail constrained decoding validators, and when function-calling payloads contain nested arrays that violate schema contracts for some model variants. This ticket codifies a deterministic e2e harness that: (1) exercises JSON Mode + constrained decoding under streaming; (2) validates function/tool calling structured outputs against multiple schema versions; (3) records per-model compatibility score and breaking-change diffs; (4) integrates as a pre-merge CI check and a nightly catalog regression job.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic test harness (CI job 'jsonmode-e2e') that runs across a representative subset of models (small/medium/large) and returns pass/fail and schema diff artifacts.

Streaming+constrained decoding scenarios covered: prefix truncation, mid-token boundaries, KV-cache replay, and partial-object assembly must be validated and either accepted or clearly flagged with actionable diffs.

Tool/function-calling outputs validated against versioned JSON schemas (v1/v2) with a compatibility score; failures must surface sample model outputs and the exact decoding step where constraint was violated.
Regression job integrated into the 'pre-merge' pipeline for core-api changes that touch JSON Mode, streaming, constrained decoding, or tool-calling code paths.
Dashboard: historical compatibility metrics for each model (last 30 days), with links to failing logs and suggested mitigation (prompt shim, constrained decoding tuning, or model pinning).
test_plan: Create harness repo job: github.com/redwood-inference/jsonmode-e2e (GH Actions matrix for model variants).
Test vectors: generate 120 prompt templates that exercise edge cases (nested objects, arrays, enums, optional/missing fields, partial arrays during streaming).
Constrained decoder: run with strict/lenient modes and capture token-level decisions; record errors with token index + decoder state dump.
Function calling matrix: test combos of streaming-enabled calls, non-streaming calls, and fallback to text mode. Include tool stubs in test harness to assert payload parsing.
CI integration: add job to 'runtime-checks' workflow; fail on new regressions unless overridden with documented ACCEPTANCE_REASON.
Nightly job: run full catalog (best-effort) and push compatibility scores to Console telemetry endpoint 'compatibility/jsonmode'.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Merge harness and minimal CI job (run subset of fast models) behind feature flag. Phase 2 (nightly): enable full-catalog runs and wire to dashboard. Phase 3: gate certain PRs (runtime changes) to block on no-new-regressions unless explicit exemption provided. Communicate to platform teams and create runbook for triage of flaky model-specific failures.
